decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for erection of a two storey side and single storey  rear and forward extension  to  9 Burlington Road, because of the position, design and appearance of the extensions, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  this property and would not be detrimental to the   
appearance of the original dwellinghouse and the character of the 
street scene, to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring 
properties or the character of the area.  The development is in 
accordance with the UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), 
H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking 
and  Servicing facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of 
Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is  compliant with 
Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 9 Burlington Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a 2 storey  side & single storey rear and front extension to existing house.
